record.t: Was appointed an associate justice of the Vermont Supreme Court by Gov. James Douglas in October 2003, after private practice in Rutland.
record.q: Justice Reiber served in the private practice of law in Rutland and as a partner in the law firm Kenlan, Schweibert & Facey from 1986 until his appointment as an associate justice by Governor James Douglas in October 2003.
